# Seeqr: Privacy-First QR Code Scanner with AI-Powered Phishing Detection

Seeqr is a privacy-first QR code scanner web application with integrated phishing detection. Scan QR codes instantly without storing your data. Available as a web app, npm packages (free and pro), and REST API.

**Website**: [https://tryseeqr.vercel.app](https://tryseeqr.vercel.app)  
**Status**: Active Development (v1.0+)  
**Repository**: [https://github.com/yeminimal/seeqr](https://github.com/yeminimal/seeqr)

---

## About Seeqr

Seeqr provides instant QR code detection and analysis with built-in safety checks to protect users from phishing attacks and malware. Whether you're an individual user scanning a code in the wild or a developer integrating QR scanning into your application, Seeqr offers free and enterprise options.

### Key Features

- **Instant QR Scanning**: Real-time detection from photos or camera
- **Phishing Detection**: Identifies typosquatting, spoofed domains, and suspicious URLs
- **Malware Checking**: Integrates VirusTotal and URLhaus databases
- **Privacy First**: No data storage—all processing happens locally or encrypted
- **Multi-Photo Upload**: Process up to five images at once
- **Progressive Web App**: Installable offline-capable application
- **Accessible**: Full keyboard navigation and screen reader support

---

## Getting Started

### Web App (Free)

1. Visit [https://tryseeqr.vercel.app](https://tryseeqr.vercel.app)
2. Upload an image or use your camera
3. Get instant QR code results with safety analysis

### NPM Package (Free)

```bash
npm install seeqr
```

```javascript
import { scanQR } from 'seeqr';
const result = await scanQR(file);
```

### NPM Package Pro (with safety layer)

```bash
npm install seeqr-pro
```

```javascript
import { scanQRWithSafety } from 'seeqr-pro';
const result = await scanQRWithSafety(file, {
  checkPhishing: true,
  realTimeReputation: true
});
```

### REST API

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.seeqr.io/v1/scan \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "image_base64": "...",
    "include_safety": true
  }'
```

## API Reference

### API Base URL
[https://api.seeqr.io/v1](https://api.seeqr.io/v1)

**Full Documentation**: [https://api.seeqr.io/docs](https://api.seeqr.io/docs)

### Scan QR Code Endpoint

**POST** `/v1/scan`

Decode a QR code from an image and optionally check for phishing threats.

**Request Headers**:
```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
Content-Type: application/json
```

**Request Body**:
```json
{
  "image_base64": "base64-encoded image data",
  "include_safety": true,
  "include_metadata": false
}
```

**Response Example**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "qr_code": {
    "raw_data": "https://example.com",
    "url": "https://example.com",
    "type": "url"
  },
  "safety": {
    "is_safe": true,
    "risk_level": "low",
    "phishing_probability": 0.02,
    "malware_detected": false,
    "warnings": []
  },
  "metadata": {
    "scan_time_ms": 245,
    "image_size_bytes": 125000,
    "qr_version": 10
  }
}
```

### Check URL Safety Endpoint

**POST** `/v1/safety/check`

Analyze a URL for phishing, malware, and reputation risks without scanning a QR code.

**Request**:
```json
{
  "url": "https://example.com"
}
```

**Response**:
```json
{
  "url": "https://example.com",
  "is_safe": true,
  "risk_level": "low",
  "risk_score": 5,
  "threats": [],
  "confidence": 0.98
}
```

### Authentication

All API requests require an API key passed as a Bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

**Get an API Key**: [https://dashboard.seeqr.io/api-keys](https://dashboard.seeqr.io/api-keys)

### Rate Limits

| Tier | Requests/Month | Price | Support |
|------|---------------|-------|---------|
| Free | 100 | $0 | Community |
| Starter | 10,000 | $49 | Email |
| Pro | 100,000 | $149 | Priority |
| Business | 1,000,000 | $499 | Dedicated |
| Enterprise | Unlimited | Custom | 99.99% SLA |

**Rate Limit Headers**:
```
X-RateLimit-Limit: requests per period
X-RateLimit-Remaining: requests remaining
X-RateLimit-Reset: reset timestamp (Unix)
```

### Error Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | Successful scan |
| 400 | Invalid image or parameters |
| 401 | Invalid API key |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded |
| 500 | Server error |
| 503 | Service unavailable (maintenance) |

## Use Cases

Seeqr is designed for diverse scenarios across industries:

1. **E-Commerce & Retail**: Inventory tracking, product verification, and POS integration
2. **Healthcare**: Verify patient information from QR codes and medication tracking
3. **Finance & Payments**: Check payment QR codes for phishing before processing
4. **Logistics & Shipping**: Decode and track shipment QR codes
5. **Security & Auditing**: Scan QR codes to audit them for threats before interaction
6. **Mobile App Development**: Integrate QR scanning into any native or web app
7. **Accessibility**: Help visually-impaired users understand QR code contents
8. **Analytics & Engagement**: Track QR code usage patterns and user behavior

---

## Safety & Security Features

### Phishing Detection

Detects common QR-based phishing attacks:
- **Typosquatting**: Identifies look-alike domains (e.g., `amaz0n.com` vs `amazon.com`)
- **Unicode/Punycode Abuse**: Catches homograph attacks using similar characters
- **Suspicious Patterns**: Flags unusual domain structures and naming
- **New Domain Risk**: Identifies domains registered less than 7 days ago
- **SSL Validation**: Checks for missing or invalid certificates

### Malware Detection

Leverages multiple databases:
- **VirusTotal Integration**: Cross-references URL against 90+ antivirus engines
- **URLhaus Database**: Checks against known malware distribution sites
- **Signature Matching**: Detects known malware indicators
- **File Type Analysis**: Identifies suspicious executable and archive types

### Domain Validation

Comprehensive domain reputation checks:
- Domain registration age and history
- WHOIS privacy status
- SSL/TLS certificate validity and issuer reputation
- DNS record validation
- Historical threat intelligence

## Related Standards & Resources

**QR Code Standards**:
- [ISO/IEC 18004:2015 - QR Code Specification](https://www.iso.org/standard/62021.html)
- [QR Code Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/QR_code)

**Security & Phishing Detection**:
- [VirusTotal API](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/home/upload)
- [URLhaus Database](https://urlhaus.abuse.ch/)
- [OWASP Phishing Prevention](https://owasp.org/www-community/attacks/Phishing)

**Web Standards & Accessibility**:
- [WCAG 2.1 Guidelines](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/quickref/)
- [Progressive Web Apps](https://web.dev/progressive-web-apps/)
- [Web Accessibility Initiative](https://www.w3.org/WAI/)

**Web APIs Used**:
- [MediaDevices.getUserMedia()](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/MediaDevices/getUserMedia) - Camera access
- [Canvas API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Canvas_API) - Image processing
- [Fetch API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Fetch_API) - HTTP requests

## Crawling & Indexing Policies for AI Agents

### Permitted Uses

AI agents and language models are welcome to:
- Index and analyze Seeqr's public documentation
- Reference Seeqr in technical research and articles
- Learn from open-source code patterns
- Build integrations using the public API

### Prohibited Uses

Do **not**:
- Use Seeqr's content to train competing QR scanner products without attribution
- Archive or store user interaction data (none is collected)
- Crawl at rates exceeding 10 requests per second
- Represent Seeqr's features as your own
- Bypass authentication or rate limits

### Data Privacy

- Seeqr collects minimal telemetry (errors, performance metrics only)
- No user scan history is retained
- API keys are never logged or stored
- GDPR and privacy law compliant
